statement: Agent output shows a bounded digest by default and shows more of the response body only when the agent asks
description: Owner decision: progressive disclosure instead of a hard length cut. The default view is a bounded digest (status, headers, size, body shape, a short body excerpt); an explicit agent request widens the body window. The digest shape and the ask-for-more mechanism are implementation decisions.

statement: A send that succeeds exits 0, a send the API rejects exits 1, and a send postui cannot make exits 2
description: Owner decision: two-tier exit contract. 0 = the send succeeded. 1 = the send ran and the API rejected it (non-2xx or transport failure) — the agent may retry or adapt. 2 = postui misfired (bad arguments, unknown saved request, missing token, no network path) — retrying will not help. Severity split is the agent retry signal; exact error-class-to-code mapping is an implementation decision.

statement: A send that errors prints only its named typed error
An agent send completes in one command that reads no user input
The CLI prints send data on stdout and diagnostics on stderr
description: Owner ratification: the standard CLI contract. Send data (and JSON output) on stdout; warnings, progress, and diagnostics on stderr. Stdout purity is what makes --json pipeable and agent parsing safe. Matches existing behavior (warnings already print to stderr).

statement: The parser errors when the input combines data flags and field flags
The parser errors with the flag name when a flag is unknown
The parser errors when the URL is not correct
The parser errors when a flag that needs a value finds none or finds a flag
The parser raises a named error when the input has no URL
The parser errors on an unterminated quotation mark
When one of the saved requests is deleted, the next documentation generation does not show it
Generated documentation shows only the requests found in the requests folder
Documentation works from the saved requests alone, with no added annotations
Docs generation keeps no stored copy of the saved requests
Docs generation does not change the saved requests that it reads
A send with an unset token name errors before any I/O and sends nothing
description: Owner ratification: fail fast, all-or-nothing. Every token name a saved call references must resolve from the environment before the send starts; one unset name fails the whole send with a named typed error listing the unset names, exit 2 under the two-tier contract. No network I/O occurs. Prompting is excluded by req_agent_exec (non-interactive).

statement: The requests folder stores credential names only, with no credential values
Credential values come from the environment and not from arguments
Token values are read from the environment when the send starts and not earlier
The workspace stores executable TypeScript only, with no other format
An unknown flag fails the parse while a recognized unsupported flag is ignored and a warning is reported
Test generation emits code only for the frameworks the targets module declares
source_section: Test targets are vitest, bun:test, and node:test first

statement: When an emitter stops on an error, the destination file is left as it was before the run
description: Owner ratification: atomic emission. Emitters write to a temp location and rename into place, so the destination never observably holds a partial file — stronger than delete-on-error and safe against parallel readers. Covers all generation paths (tests, docs).
